transforms.name: normalized-card
transforms.effect: effort is emitted as an event or monitor upsert. Antigravity does this only from launch options.

transforms.name: reduce-card
transforms.effect: model:updated and effort:updated upsert or retract. Null retracts. Configured and observed stay distinct.

transforms.name: derive-card
transforms.effect: derive copies model displayName or id, and effort value plus intent when present.
